chapters.title: Cyclic replacements
chapters.code:
def rotate(nums, k):
    n = len(nums)
    k %= n
    moved = start = 0
    while moved < n:
        i, carry = start, nums[start]
        while True:
            j = (i + k) % n
            nums[j], carry = carry, nums[j]
            i = j
            moved += 1
            if i == start:
                break
        start += 1

frames.caption: Cyclic replacements — O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Input: rotate(nums=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], k=3). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
